title: PHP 8.3.3 Released!
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 8.3.3. This is a bug fix release.

All PHP 8.3 users are encouraged to upgrade to this version.

For source downloads of PHP 8.3.3 please visit our , Windows source and binaries can be found on . The list of changes is recorded in the . downloads pagewindows.php.net/download/ChangeLog
